column3: The related Non-Serviced Special Servicer under the VRTX 2025-HQ TSA will be entitled to a workout fee determined, with respect to each applicable principal and interest collection, at a workout fee rate equal to 0.5000% of each payment of principal and interest (other than default interest) made on the VRTX Q Whole Loan for so long as another Special Servicing Loan Event does occur.
